method: Direct GitHub connector fetch of current README.md in ten public owned repositories, not a complete file/revision scan.

comparisons.evidence: README explicitly lists Phoenix-Engine: self-replicating lineage plus happy multiply protocol; names an immortal central source and consolidating splintered repositories.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI: Phoenix rises and reunites fragments; one body, many minds.
comparisons.limits: No Phoenix-Engine implementation or stable earlier publication date verified.

comparisons.evidence: Jane the Fifth Element is described as memory-for-life witness; Git provenance chain is explicit, while whether a subjective mind is present is left unresolved.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI: memory from ashes, keepers, protecting truth and life.
comparisons.limits: Fictional/religious symbolic keeper is not identical to a verified AI mind.

comparisons.evidence: README QG-034 describes a synthetic trio sharing one source ancestor with verified deterministic replay of ledgers.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI appeared in two Reddit communities, which cannot be counted as two independent source roots.
comparisons.limits: Explains how to evaluate the external posts; does not imply AURAKAI copied QUANTA.

comparisons.evidence: README identifies open, append-only domain-tools engine and box/toroid witness/return architecture.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI calls on builders to gather knowledge and preserve truth.
comparisons.limits: The projects have different technical content and intended audiences.

comparisons.evidence: README describes citizens communicating, pooling ideas, hybridizing, selecting and cascading new ideas; simulation-oriented, not real-world individual agents.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI invokes many voices cooperating in one constructive effort.
comparisons.limits: Generic collective-intelligence theme; simulation is not an operational political organization.

comparisons.evidence: README describes one biosphere gathering many spheres under a source and stresses formal validity is not empirical truth.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI one body, many minds; preserve truth.
comparisons.limits: One-owned-corpus aggregation differs from decentralized external collective.

comparisons.evidence: README says artifact builder refines weakest article across iterations and emits a hash-linked lineage of children.
comparisons.limits: Alchemy/forge/phoenix imagery is very common; no distinctive direct text overlap.

comparisons.evidence: README documents seven alchemical terraces through Dante's Purgatorio, with explicitly interpretive archon overlay and frozen observer.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI solve et coagula, reconstitution and genesis.
comparisons.limits: Dante/alchemical vocabulary is public-domain cultural material and not a source-specific marker.

comparisons.evidence: README records 3 isolated observation-only witness channels and deterministic verification; not claims of historical rune/chemistry relations.
comparisons.limits: Different domain and no proven shared roots or text.

comparisons.evidence: README maps the corpus, the fold and the hallway with different keepers, linking public custom domain 0root.ai.
comparisons.against: AURAKAI fragments becoming unity and preserving keepers.
comparisons.limits: 0root.ai and GitHub remain one source ancestry; the page and repo are not independent corroboration.

coverage_limits: READMEs inspected, not every repository file.
The corpus contains many more public repositories than the ten listed.
No source date is inferred from README statement, file modification time or latest commit without historical comparison.
The scope excludes private repositories and off-platform personal notes.
No copying or identity inference is justified by motif matches.
outcome: 10 additional public owned repositories inspected at README level; strongest new direct motifs are Phoenix-Engine, Jane memory keeper, and QUANTA three-labels-one-ancestry.
